arXiv:2610.13602v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum entanglement is a fundamental resource in quantum information science, commonly consumed to perform tasks like quantum teleportation and quantum key distribution. In this finite regime, and at the low error levels relevant in practice, performance is penalized by corrections that reduce the achievable yield.
